page_title: PSG 5-0 REN | PSG v Rennes 06/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Marc Bollengier is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' The game is interrupted. Marquinhos (PSG) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
90+4' PSG quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

90+1' 5 - 0 Nice piece of skill by Goncalo Ramos (PSG). He perfectly collected a pass from Ousmane Dembele and unleashed a fantastic long-range strike which went into the bottom right corner. The score is 5:0.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' PSG take a short corner kick.

90' Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play. PSG are awarded a corner kick.
88' 4 - 0 Goal! Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG) is teed up on the edge of the box by Quentin Ndjantou, and his howitzer of a shot inside the right post gives the keeper no chance. 4:0.
87' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
87' Fabian Ruiz (PSG) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball. PSG have been awarded a corner kick.
87' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Ousmane Dembele (PSG) takes it short.
82' Habib Beye has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ludovic Blas (Rennes) replacing Mahdi Camara.
82' Substitution. Breel Embolo makes his way off the pitch and Mohamed Meite (Rennes) comes on as his replacement.
82' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Elias Legendre (Rennes) comes onto the pitch so that Mousa Tamari can be given a rest.
81' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) works the corner short.
80' Luis Enrique prepares a substitution. Joao Neves is replaced by Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG).
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Warren Zaire-Emery trots off the pitch and is replaced by Quentin Ndjantou (PSG).
80' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. The ball is out of play and PSG manage to earn a corner.
78' PSG are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
76' Substitution. Esteban Lepaul leaves the pitch and is replaced by Anthony Rouault (Rennes).

75' Marquinhos (PSG) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and floats high over the bar.
74' Jeremy Jacquet (Rennes) makes a bad challenge and is given a second yellow card which means he's off.

72' Bradley Barcola (PSG) accelerated away from the defence and took his shot early from the edge of the box. The ball flew towards the left side of the goal, but Brice Samba made a superb athletic save to deny him.
71' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from PSG comes to nothing.
71' A substitution has been made. Vitinha is replaced by Fabian Ruiz (PSG).
71' Luis Enrique decides to make a substitution. Khvicha Kvaratskhelia will be replaced by Goncalo Ramos (PSG).
70' The free kick from Vitinha (PSG) failed to provide any scoring opportunity, as one of the defenders did a good job and knocked it out. Good work from PSG as they win a corner.
69' Abdelhamid Ait Boudlal (Rennes) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.

67' 3 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) fires a brilliant volley into the roof of the net from the edge of the box, leaving the goalkeeper helpless. Senny Mayulu provided the assist. What a finish! 3:0.
67' Senny Mayulu (PSG) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
65' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) had a great opportunity from mid-range. His powerful low volley was directed towards the middle of the net, but Brice Samba was alert and made an astonishing save!
64' Here is a change. Kang-In Lee is going off and Luis Enrique gives the last tactical orders to Ousmane Dembele (PSG).
64' Marc Bollengier has a clear sight and sees a foul from Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG).
62' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
60' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.

58' Bradley Barcola (PSG) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Brice Samba makes a decent save to deny his effort directed to the bottom left corner.
56' Quentin Merlin (Rennes) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

54' What a great effort! Breel Embolo (Rennes) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the left post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal.
53' Jeremy Jacquet (Rennes) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.

50' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the left post. Brice Samba pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
50' PSG take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

49' Bradley Barcola (PSG) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for PSG.
49' Senny Mayulu (PSG) latches onto a short pass just on the edge of the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper but comes back off the crossbar. Close!
48' Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
46' Habib Beye makes a half-time substitution. Quentin Merlin (Rennes) comes on in place of Djaoui Cisse.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' Marc Bollengier has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' What a chance that is! Kang-In Lee (PSG) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
43' Kang-In Lee (PSG) receives a sweet pass, but fails to score as he blazes the ball just over the bar.
42' Kang-In Lee (PSG) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
39' 2 - 0 Fantastic team goal! Senny Mayulu (PSG) was set free in the area by Joao Neves and he made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom left corner. 2:0.
35' Willian Pacho (PSG) is able to continue to play.
34' Willian Pacho (PSG) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.

33' Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) was in a good shooting position just outside the box and unleashed a first-time shot towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper made a decent save to thwart his effort.
33' A quickly taken corner by Rennes.
33' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Rennes) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Rennes.
33' Valentin Rongier (Rennes) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
32' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. Rennes will have a chance to score from a corner.
31' Djaoui Cisse (Rennes) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
31' Rennes failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. The referee blows his whistle, Rennes are awarded a corner kick.

28' 1 - 0 Goal! Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom left corner. Brice Samba had no chance of reaching it. The score is 1:0.
28' Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) is found in space by a decent pass, and he immediately hits a rocket of a shot at goal that clips the outside of the left post.
28' Rennes work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
27' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Mousa Tamari (Rennes). Now Rennes have a corner.
25' Bradley Barcola (PSG) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
23' 65:35 – the ratio of ball possession.
21' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
20' Marc Bollengier blows his whistle after Joao Neves (PSG) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
19' Bradley Barcola (PSG) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
16' Willian Pacho (PSG) is penalised for holding. Marc Bollengier signals a set piece.
13' Some great controlled play and passing from PSG. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
9' Vitinha (PSG) picks up a pass and fires a powerful long-range shot which goes painfully close to the left post.
9' Senny Mayulu (PSG) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
6' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
3' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
1' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Rennes) hits a good looking first-time shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly over the bar.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Rennes will have the kick-off.
Marc Bollengier was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
